text: Ask who may mark a source as usable for an article, and whether that action is tied to a signed-in person. Ask whether an administrator or a scheduled job can act on someone's behalf. Ask whether a changed quote needs a fresh decision before the writer can use it again. Ask what happens to a sentence that already sits in a draft when its source is withdrawn. Ask to see, for one article, which facts were used, which were left out and why.
